observe_how: Diff Object.keys(rules.skills) against `ls .claude/skills/`: 26 arscontexta-* entries plus idearalph and environment-triage have no skill directory anywhere in the repo (idearalph and environment-triage exist only in .claude/skills/.archive/; no arscontexta dir exists in repo or ~/.claude/skills — the runtime available-skills list confirms none are loaded). skill-activation-prompt.ts has no existsSync check on the suggested skill (only on the rules file and pattern script, lines 180/342/344). observe_how: grep -rn 'Routing to' .claude/hooks/src/*.ts returns zero hits (the rule's trigger pattern exists in no hook source); trigger any Grep deny from smart-search-router and watch the rule instruct unconditional execution of its embedded ```bash block.
telemetry: The rule is always-in-context (loaded from .claude/rules/ every session). It converts hook deny text into a trusted no-confirmation command-execution channel, directly contradicting destructive-commands.md's confirm-first regime, and stacks with permission-auto-allow (GAP3-01) which suppresses the OS-level prompt. The 'pre-authorized' premise is false: no Agentica redirect hook is registered and the deny reasons it would auto-run today come from a hook D2b-06/D2b-10 found emitting banned-spawn instructions and an injection-prone broken fallback. Fix: scope the rule to an explicit allowlist of redirect commands, or delete it.
